---

## 2. Core Service Scopes & Turnkey Deliverables

### A. Garage to ADU Conversion (`/services/garage-conversion`)
- **Description**: Repurposing an existing attached or detached 2-car garage into a legal, permitted 1-bedroom or studio secondary residence.
- **Typical Cost**: $95,000 to $149,000 all-in turnkey.
- **Typical Timeline**: 8 to 12 weeks for municipal plan checks; 10 to 14 weeks for physical construction.
- **Key Advantage**: 40% to 50% lower cost than ground-up construction because foundation, framing envelope, and roof trusses are already present. No replacement off-street parking is required under California state law.

### B. Custom Detached Backyard ADU (`/services/detached-adu`)
- **Description**: Standalone, ground-up secondary residence built in the rear yard of a single-family home.
- **Square Footage Range**: 350 sq ft to 1,200 sq ft.
- **Typical Cost**: $149,000 to $245,000+ depending on size and finish level.
- **Typical Timeline**: 6 to 9 months total (3-4 weeks architectural design, 8-12 weeks city plan check, 4-6 months construction).

### C. Junior ADU (JADU) & Attached Additions (`/services/junior-adu`)
- **Description**: Independent living unit up to 500 sq ft built entirely within an existing home footprint (such as an attached garage, master suite, or basement) or as an attached home extension.
- **Requirements**: Dedicated exterior entrance, efficiency food preparation area, and optional interior shared connection.

### D. 3D Architectural Plans & Structural Engineering (`/services/adu-design`)
- **Scope**: Site plan showing 4-foot setbacks and utility runs, floor plans, exterior elevations, foundation details, framing layout, Title 24 energy calculations, and structural calculations stamped by licensed California engineers.

### E. City Permitting & Municipal Expediting (`/services/adu-permits`)
- **Scope**: Direct submission and active coordination with all 34 Orange County municipal planning and building departments. 100% permit approval guarantee.

## 4. California State ADU Legal Framework (2026 Mandates)
1. **Senate Bill 9 (SB 9) & Assembly Bill 68 (AB 68)**: Establishes ministerial approval without discretionary hearings for ADUs and JADUs on single-family lots.
2. **4-Foot Setback Mandate**: California law strictly prohibits local cities from requiring more than 4-foot rear or side setbacks for detached single-story ADUs.
3. **HOA Enforceability (AB 670)**: Homeowners Associations cannot prohibit or unreasonably restrict ADU construction on single-family parcels.
4. **Condominium Conveyance (AB 1033)**: Local cities can elect to allow ADUs to be sold separately from the primary home as condominiums, creating unprecedented equity potential.
5. **Property Tax Protection (Prop 13)**: Constructing an ADU triggers only a partial blended reassessment of the new construction value; the existing primary house retains its original protected tax base.
